وزير الدولة بوزارة الخارجية @Dr_Al_Khulaifi يجتمع مع النائب الأول لوزير الخارجية الياباني

طوكيو | 22 أكتوبر 2026

اجتمع سعادة الدكتور محمد بن عبدالعزيز بن صالح الخليفي، وزير الدولة بوزارة الخارجية، اليوم في طوكيو، مع سعادة السيد هيرويوكي نامازو، النائب الأول لوزير خارجية اليابان.

جرى خلال الاجتماع استعراض علاقات التعاون بين البلدين وسبل دعمها وتطويرها، ومناقشة آخر المستجدات الإقليمية والدولية والجهود الدبلوماسية الرامية إلى خفض التصعيد وتعزيز الأمن والاستقرار.

وجدد سعادة وزير الدولة بوزارة الخارجية، خلال الاجتماع، دعم دولة قطر لكافة الجهود الدبلوماسية والمساعي الرامية إلى حل يضمن حرية الملاحة البحرية، ويمهد الطريق للتوصل إلى اتفاق شامل يحقق السلام المستدام في المنطقة.
 
من جانبه أكد سعادة النائب الأول لوزير خارجية اليابان، أن الوساطة تمثل ركيزة أساسية في السياسة الخارجية لدولة قطر، مشدداً على أهمية الحوار وبناء الثقة وتهيئة الظروف الملائمة للحلول السياسية، بما يعزز الأمن والسلم الدوليين.

posts.text:
BEN HOROWITZ SAYS AMAZON $AMZN CEO ANDY JASSY TOLD HIM AI SUPPLY IS SOLD OUT BEYOND 2028

"I said, yeah, like we're out of everything till 2028. He's like, oh, it's beyond 2028."

Then he explained why that makes AI nothing like the dot-com bubble

"In the internet bubble, we didn't have enough demand because we had to build the internet. People had to get broadband. Originally they had to get their browser at Fry's. There weren't enough consumers on the internet to absorb all the bandwidth that had gotten built out."

"The lack of demand killed it. We don't really have a lack of demand in AI, so I think the dynamics will be different."

He did flag one risk. "If you get into a pathological debt situation, that can wreck anybody."

He said that's why Andreessen Horowitz isn't invested in any of the neoclouds. "That whole thing scares me, having been through it."

ON THIS DAY IN 1879, THOMAS EDISON CREATED THE FIRST PRACTICAL, LONG-LASTING LIGHT BULB

For months, his bulbs had burned out after just a few hours. His platinum filament kept melting.

The fix came while he was idly rolling a piece of carbon between his fingers. It gave him an idea: turn other materials into carbon and use them as the filament.

He tried a carbonized cotton thread inside a glass vacuum bulb, and it gave off a soft orange glow.

It burned for about 15 hours.

OVER 75% OF NEW TESLA $TSLA BUYERS IN NORTH AMERICA ARE NOW TAKING FSD (SUPERVISED)

That's up nearly 20 percentage points from last quarter.

Active FSD subscriptions hit 1.74 million, up 67% from a year ago. FSD is now approved in 9 EU countries, where more than 100,000 customers have already driven over 160 million kilometers with it.

posts.name: WOLF
posts.text:
TESLA $TSLA ROBOTAXI MILES GREW 8X IN ONE QUARTER

Tesla started giving Robotaxi rides in Cybercabs in Austin on September 3, and the service is now running from 6am to midnight.

It reached nearly 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles by the end of the quarter. Riders can even use Grok inside the Cybercab to manage their inbox, calendar and tasks by voice.

posts.name: WOLF
posts.text:
THE TESLA $TSLA SEMI IS NOW IN VOLUME PRODUCTION

The top version can go 500 miles fully loaded at 82,000 lbs, at an efficiency of 1.7 kWh per mile.

That means it uses about a third of the energy of a comparable diesel truck to haul the same load. In trucking, energy is one of the biggest costs per mile, so Tesla says that gives Semi operators a real advantage.

The Nevada factory is built for 25,000 Semis a year, and Tesla deployed its first pre-assembled Megacharger to support the ramp.

posts.name: WOLF
posts.text:
TESLA $TSLA HAS NOW TOPPED $100 BILLION IN TRAILING 12-MONTH REVENUE FOR THE SECOND STRAIGHT QUARTER

And its margins are moving higher too

Gross margin climbed to 19.6% in Q3, up from 16.8% last quarter and 18.0% a year ago.

Its services and other business also posted a record $734 million in gross profit, with revenue up 33% from a year ago thanks to charging, insurance and parts sales.

BREAKING: The NAHB Housing Market Index fell -3 points in October, to 29, its lowest level since June 2012.

This marks the 2nd consecutive monthly decline in homebuilder sentiment, totaling -6 points, marking the largest 2-month decrease since June 2025.

All 3 components deteriorated, with current sales falling -2 points, to 33, the lowest since June 2012.

Sales expectations dropped -5 points, to 32, the lowest since November 2022, while buyer traffic plunged -5 points, to 18, the lowest since April 2012, excluding the 2020 pandemic.

Furthermore, 43% of builders cut prices this month, the highest proportion of any month from 2020 to 2026.

The affordability crisis is putting further pressure on homebuilder sentiment.

US private equity firms are struggling to attract new capital:

Private equity funds raised just $222 billion from investors in the first 9 months of 2026, on track for the weakest year since 2020. 

This would also mark the 3rd consecutive annual decline.

By comparison, the industry attracted $406 billion in full year 2023 and $330 billion last year.

Higher rates have made it harder for private equity firms to sell businesses at attractive prices, weakening investment returns and prompting investors to become more reluctant to commit capital to new funds.

Smaller firms managing less than $15 billion are facing the most pressure.

Private equity has lost its shine in the rapidly evolving macroeconomic backdrop.
